chunks: What al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from 'Ubayd ibn Mu'awiyah ibn Shurayh, from his father, from Ibn Sinan, who said:

I said to Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام: These people bring us these partridges. He said: Do not approach them in the Haram except what has been slaughtered. I said: We instruct them to slaughter them there. He said: Yes, eat it and feed me from it.

key_terms.أَطْعِمْنِيهِ: feed me from it, further affirming permissibility
key_terms.الْحَرَمِ: the sacred sanctuary area in which special legal restrictions apply
key_terms.الْيَعَاقِيبِ: partridges or a type of hunted bird being brought for consumption
key_terms.مَذْبُوحًا: slaughtered according to the required legal method

ai.seo_question: Can hunted game slaughtered outside the Haram be eaten inside the Haram?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on consuming hunted game in the Haram when it was slaughtered outside it. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام permits eating it in the Haram if it had already been slaughtered in the lawful area, indicating a legal distinction between live game and properly slaughtered meat.
